description: Canonical branch-retention desired state. Branch existence is not release evidence; annotated tags and published releases are. A branch is removable only when its commits are reachable from main or from a tag that has a published release.

active.description: Long-lived branches required by the development workflow. Never deleted by maintenance.

releaseEvidence.description: Immutable release evidence. Carried by tags and published releases rather than by branches, so no branch belongs to this class.

disposable.description: Work and release-preparation branches. Removable once merged and covered by release evidence.
